arcŭātim , adv. id.,
I.in the form of a bow (perh. only in the foll. exs.): “millepeda animal multis pedibus arcuatim repens,” Plin. 29, 6, 39, § 136 : sanguis arcuatim fluens, Fest. s. v. Tullios, p. 352 Müll.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
